changeset.li: New upstream version, the one of Debian Forky, with Debian's patches
libcap2 and libcap-dev have the new library libpsx
libpam-cap has capability.conf and Debian's profile for pam-auth-update, which it calls when it is installed and removed
mkcapshdoc.sh runs with a POSIX shell, the build does not need bash
Adaptation of Debian sources for Bolt OS
